description: Type annotations and class definitions for protobuf message classes related to data broker operations, including requests and responses for updating, streaming, and registering datapoints in a data broker system.

classes.name: UpdateDatapointsRequest
classes.description: Protobuf message class for requesting datapoint updates, containing a map of datapoints.

classes.name: UpdateDatapointsReply
classes.description: Protobuf message class for reply to datapoint update requests, containing errors map.

classes.name: StreamDatapointsRequest
classes.description: Protobuf message class for streaming datapoints, containing a map of datapoints.

classes.name: StreamDatapointsReply
classes.description: Protobuf message class for streaming datapoints reply, containing errors map.

classes.name: RegisterDatapointsRequest
classes.description: Protobuf message class for registering datapoints, containing a list of registration metadata.

classes.name: RegistrationMetadata
classes.description: Protobuf message class for metadata about a datapoint, including name, data type, description, and change type.

classes.name: RegisterDatapointsReply
classes.description: Protobuf message class for reply to datapoint registration, mapping datapoint names to IDs.

methods.name: ClearField
methods.description: Method to clear a specified field in protobuf message.
